verdict.rationale: Hightouch's docs confirm a sync-run debugger for checking runs and debugging rejected rows, plus configurable alerts when a run fails, and community evidence (comm-5) explicitly calls out 'live debugger, alerting' as differentiating developer-facing features versus competitors. However, there is no direct evidence of a live event-stream view (watching events flow in real time) or per-destination delivery metrics dashboards beyond the sync debugger and alerting. Missing for 10: live event flow visualization, per-destination delivery metrics/dashboards, and independent hands-on confirmation of debugger usability at scale.
